bug_semantics: CWE-915 mass assignment in @adonisjs/lucid BaseModel.merge() (propagating to fill/create/updateOrCreate and bulk writers) and later $consumeAdapterResult(). After column/relation checks, any payload key that passes this.hasOwnProperty(key) is assigned with this[key] = value. Internal ORM fields ($attributes, $original, $isPersisted, $isDeleted, $preloaded, $extras, $sideloaded, fillInvoked, forceUpdate, and similar) are initialized as own instance properties, so they satisfy that check. Unfiltered input such as request.all() can therefore set $isPersisted and force save() down the UPDATE path, overwrite $attributes/$original, or flip $isDeleted. Applications that drop unknown keys with a strict allowlist are not affected.
